description: This file contains utility functions for the Calculator app, including exception handling, string manipulation, system time retrieval, file I/O, color comparison, and UI thread execution. It also includes functions for HTML escaping and contrast color calculation, specific to the application's UI and system interactions.

methods.name: IFTPlatformException
methods.description: Handles HRESULT errors by throwing a Platform::Exception if the HRESULT indicates failure.

methods.name: GetDoubleFromWstring
methods.description: Converts a wstring to a double after removing unwanted characters.

methods.name: GetWindowId
methods.description: Retrieves the current window's application view ID.

methods.name: RunOnUIThreadNonblocking
methods.description: Executes a given function on the UI thread asynchronously without blocking.

methods.name: IsLastCharacterTarget
methods.description: Checks if the last character of a wstring matches a target wchar_t.

methods.name: GetUniversalSystemTime
methods.description: Retrieves the current system time in a DateTime object with universal time.

methods.name: IsDateTimeOlderThan
methods.description: Determines if a given DateTime is older than a specified duration.

methods.name: WriteFileToFolder
methods.description: Asynchronously writes text contents to a file within a specified folder.

methods.name: ReadFileFromFolder
methods.description: Asynchronously reads text contents from a file within a specified folder.

methods.name: AreColorsEqual
methods.description: Compares two Color objects for equality.

methods.name: Trim
methods.description: Trims whitespace from both ends of a String^.

methods.name: TrimFront
methods.description: Removes leading whitespace from a wstring.

methods.name: TrimBack
methods.description: Removes trailing whitespace from a wstring.
